desc: 镜面银盘配信号绿方向屏，空弹窗与留白波形承载查找功能叙事
leaf: 随身物品蓝牙定位追踪器
name: 可拆卸随身定位追踪器款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代镜银盘面与白环的极简形制。
用拇指与食指轻捏圆盘的姿态，一秒传达轻小可随身的主张。
用手机上方浮现的空白配对弹窗讲清一碰即连的低门槛设置。
用嵌在同心圆环中的圆盘与外扩声波涟漪，可视化响亮的呼叫提示音。
用满幅信号绿上的白箭头指向微缩圆盘，呈现精确寻向的临场感。
把追踪器挂上背包拉链、手入侧袋的瞬间，完成防丢场景的自我代入。
用悬浮圆盘下溅起的水珠与散开沙粒实证防泼溅防尘的耐用等级。
收口促单，用行李箱插画弹窗与空白按钮讲清可限时共享位置的安心感。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cloud white #F7F7F8 sweep for product and hand frames, saturated signal-green #2FBF54 full field reserved for the single wayfinding screen, soft graphite gradient #3A3D42 inside the one lifestyle bag frame, no warm tones
style.direction: minimal mirror-silver tracker commerce with signal-green wayfinding accents
style.iconSystem: one bold white direction arrow on the green field, thin concentric sound ripples, blank pill buttons with no words, no app icon grids, no platform marks
style.lightingSystem: clean diffused studio light near 6500K, a long soft gradient sweep across the mirror face, crisp thin rim on the white ring edge, shadowless UI screens, low warm spill only inside the lifestyle frame
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal mirror-silver tracker ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mirror silver #C9CBCE, charcoal arc #26282B, signal green #2FBF54 and cloud white #F7F7F8; clean diffused studio light near 6500K laying a long soft gradient across the mirror face with a crisp thin rim on the white ring and shadowless UI screens; cloud-white sweep, a saturated signal-green field only for the wayfinding screen and a graphite gradient only inside the lifestyle bag frame, no warm tones, no wood, no marble; one quiet geometric sans kept as empty placeholder slots; one bold white direction arrow, thin concentric ripples and blank pill buttons; plain mirror disc with blank centre and no engravings; no color palette changes, no readable engravings, no figures, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable engravings or app branding
style.presentationRules: the tracker disc always shows a plain mirror face with a blank centre and the diagonal charcoal arc, no engraved words or fruit-shaped logos, phone screens are blank white sheets with empty pill buttons, hands are generic with no identity
style.surfaceSystem: glossy cloud-white sweep, brushed mirror disc with a diagonal charcoal arc, matte white silicone ring, rippled sand grains and clear splash droplets confined to the durability frame, waxed canvas bag texture in the lifestyle frame, no wood, no marble
style.typography: one quiet geometric sans in charcoal or white, every headline, popup title and button label kept as an empty placeholder
